mapper.select: select m.id,m.music_name,m.album_id,m.musician_id,m.duration,m.cover_url,m.is_vip,m.status, u.username as musicianName, a.album_name,l.updated_time from music as m left join user as u on m.musician_id=u.id left join album as a on m.album_id=a.id left join like_record l on m.id=l.target_id where m.id=#{targetId} and l.user_Id=#{userId}

SELECT m.id, m.music_name AS musicName, m.album_id AS albumId, m.musician_id AS musicianId, m.duration, m.cover_url AS coverUrl, m.is_vip AS isVip, m.status, -- 音乐人名称 IFNULL(u.stage_name, '未知音乐人') AS musicianName, -- 专辑名称 IFNULL(a.album_name, '未知专辑') AS albumName, l.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM music AS m
LEFT JOIN musician AS u ON m.musician_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN album AS a ON m.album_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN like_record AS l ON m.id = l.target_id and l.target_type=1 AND l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.is_canceled = 0
WHERE l.id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.updated_time DESC
